answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before it may vote on trades or earn reputation. When independent counterparties report fraud, a threshold of signed reports triggers an audit; proven deception burns the stake and removes the identity’s reputation. A Sybil operator must therefore fund every extra persona, while coordinated fakes risk losing all their deposits. The knoll, delta, and garden markets can share this rule without treating a long list of cheap accounts as many trusted agents.
